fields.help_en:
The list of component IDs. The components are layered from bottom to top in the order they are listed. The components are switched in sync with the video source.

This parameter is required and takes effect only when the node type is Component.

If the node type is Resource, the components are attached to the video source and switched in sync
fields.help_zh:
组件列表。按照元素顺序由下而上排列，组件将与视频源同步切换

当节点类型为Component时，本参数才有用且必传。
当节点类型为Resource时，表示组件与视频源绑定并同步切换
fields.name: component_id

fields.help_en: The end time. The time is in UTC. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
fields.name: end_time

fields.help_en: The program ID. If you add a program for the production studio by calling the [AddCasterEpisode]() operation, use the value of the EpisodeId parameter that is returned in the response
fields.help_zh: 节目ID。如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848068.html添加导播台节目，请查看AddCasterEpisode接口调用返回的参数EpisodeId值
fields.name: episode_id

fields.help_en:
The program type. Valid values:

Resource: video source.

Component: component
fields.help_zh:
节目类型。取值：

Resource：视频源。
Component：组件
fields.name: episode_type

fields.help_en: The ID of the video source. If you add a video source for the production studio by calling the [AddCasterVideoResource]() operation, use the value of the ResourceId parameter that is returned in the response
fields.help_zh: 视频源ID。 如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848020.html添加导播台视频源，请查看AddCasterVideoResource接口调用返回的参数ResourceId值
fields.name: resource_id

fields.help_en: The start time. The time is in UTC. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
fields.name: start_time

fields.help_en:
The switch policy. This parameter is valid only when the node type is Resource.

TimeFirst: time-first. This is the only valid policy for live stream video sources.

ContentFirst: content-first
fields.help_zh:
切换策略。 节点类型为Resource视频源时有效。
          
TimeFirst：时间优先，直播类视频源只允许采用时间优先。 
ContentFirst：内容优先
fields.name: switch_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio.

If you create a production studio by calling the [CreateCaster]() operation, use the value of the CasterId parameter that is returned in the response.

If you create a production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to the Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio page to view the ID.

The name of the production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。
如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台页面查看。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

CasterId.description_en: The ID of the production studio
